# Packages the Linux E2E desktop needs. One per line; blank lines and
# "#" comments are ignored.
#
# This file is the single source of truth for the list AND the apt-archive
# cache key: the "Cache apt archives" step in test.yml hashes it, so editing
# this list invalidates the cache automatically and the two can never drift.
#
# Why each one is here (and what was deliberately left out) is documented
# above the "Install desktop tools (Linux)" step in test.yml.

imagemagick           # `import`, the primary screenshot path
openbox               # honours window.newWindowDimensions=maximized
picom                 # the compositor — without it nothing shows through
xwallpaper            # green root backdrop, via the root-pixmap atoms
x11-xserver-utils     # xsetroot, an uncomposited last resort
